about: Rough construction cost rates: national averages for a custom-built house, in 2026 dollars, multiplied by measured quantities and a location factor. A planning figure for comparing options, never a quote or a bid. lib.js costOf() reads this file; DATA.md explains each line.

slab.label: Foundation, slab on grade
slab.src: Angi/HomeAdvisor foundation cost guides (2025): slab $4-$14/sf; set near the top for thickened edges, vapour barrier and edge insulation. NAHB 2024 Cost of Constructing a Home: foundations 10.5% of construction cost.

crawl.label: Foundation, crawlspace
crawl.src: Angi (2025): crawl space $6-$18/sf on stem walls or piers; mid-range taken.

piers.label: Foundation, piers and beams
piers.src: Angi (2025): pier and beam $6-$15/sf; mid-range taken.

floorFraming.unit: sf of framed floor not on a slab
floorFraming.label: Floor framing
floorFraming.src: NAHB 2024: framing (incl. trusses and sheathing) 16.6% of $428,215 on 2,647 sf; floor joists and subfloor taken as about a third, rounded to $10/sf.

walls.label: Exterior walls (frame, sheathing, insulation, cladding)
walls.src: NAHB 2024: exterior wall finish 5.7%, wall framing and insulation from framing 16.6% and insulation 1.6%, spread over about 3,300 sf of wall, gives about $18/sf for production siding; raised to $28 for wood or metal cladding on a custom house (assumption).

roof.label: Roof (structure, insulation, roofing, trim)
roof.src: NAHB 2024: roofing 3.9% plus roof framing; asphalt about $8/sf of roof, standing-seam metal $12-$16/sf (Angi 2025); framing, insulation, soffit and gutters about $10-$12/sf.

glass.unit: sf of windows and glazed doors
glass.label: Windows and glazed doors
glass.src: Fixr (2025): fiberglass or clad casements $1,600-$2,300 installed, about $105-$150/sf; HomeAdvisor (2025): sliding doors $1,200-$4,500 each, about $25-$95/sf; large fixed panes cost less per sf. Blended $80/sf.

mep.label: Heating, cooling and electrical
mep.src: NAHB 2024: electrical 6.4%, HVAC 6.3%, lighting 1.3% of $428,215 on 2,647 sf, about $21.50/sf.

bath.label: Bathroom plumbing and fixtures
bath.src: NAHB 2024: plumbing 6.3% plus fixtures 1.9%, about $35,000 for a 2.5-bath house; about $9,000 a full bath after the base below.

plumbingBase.unit: house (kitchen, laundry, water heater, supply and drain)
plumbingBase.label: Base plumbing
plumbingBase.src: Same NAHB 2024 plumbing total, less the per-bath share.

finishes.label: Interior finishes (drywall, trim, doors, paint, floors)
finishes.src: NAHB 2024: insulation, drywall, trim and doors, painting, flooring, fireplace 15.4% of $428,215 on 2,647 sf, about $25/sf; raised to $30 for custom work (assumption).

kitchen.label: Kitchen cabinets, counters and appliances
kitchen.src: NAHB 2024: cabinets and countertops 4.5%, appliances 1.8%, about $27,000; rounded up.

stair.label: Interior stairs
stair.src: Assumption: a site-built straight or L stair with rail, $4,000-$8,000.

porch.unit: sf of porch or deck at floor level (its roof is in Roof)
porch.label: Porches and decks
porch.src: Angi (2025): wood deck $25-$50/sf with footings, framing, decking and rail.

site.label: Site work and fees allowance
site.src: NAHB 2024: site work (permits, impact and utility fees, design and engineering) 7.6%, driveway 2.3%, landscaping 2.2%, clean-up 0.7%: about $55,000. No septic, well, long drive or rock.

overhead.label: Builder overhead and profit
overhead.src: Assumption: custom builders' cost-plus fees run 10-20%. NAHB 2024 production builders: overhead 5.7% and profit 11.0% of the sale price.

location.src: Location factor = 1 + 0.45 x (state mean hourly wage / US mean - 1), with 0.45 assumed as labour's share of house construction cost. Wages: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025, construction and extraction occupations (SOC 47-0000), mean hourly wage; US $31.42 (series OEUN000000000000047000003 and OEUS<state>0000000000047000003, fetched 2026-10-28). Alaska and Hawaii add 0.15 for shipped materials (assumption).
